title: Innokin Z Force Tank 2ml
description: Discover the ultimate vaping experience with the Innokin Z Force Sub-Ohm Tank. Boasting exceptional performance and unparalleled flavour, this cutting-edge tank is perfect for both beginners looking to take their first steps into sub-ohm vaping and advanced vapers alike. Built with high-quality stainless steel and Pyrex glass, the Z Force Tank is designed to withstand the rigors of daily use, ensuring long-lasting performance and reliability. Refilling your tank has never been easier or cleaner. With its secure top-fill system, simply slide the top cap to reveal the fill port, and you'll be able to top up your e-liquid without any mess or hassle. Personalize your vaping experience with the Z Force Tank's adjustable airflow control. Whether you prefer a tight draw or airy clouds, you can fine-tune the airflow to your liking for the perfect vape every time. The Z Force Tank is compatible with a variety of coil options, allowing you to experiment with different resistances and materials to find the perfect match for your vaping style. Innokin’s latest ZF coil series , compatible with the Z Force tank, are equipped with Innokin's innovative DuoPrime coil technology, which features a unique combination of mesh and wicking materials. This ensures rapid and even heating, delivering intense flavour and massive vapor production. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
